## Blog posts
- [Building Topshe: a voice assistant in the browser](https://saswatasg.com/blog/topshe-browser-voice-ai): An experiment in browser-local language models, voice interaction and practical integration choices.
- [TGB Hunt: orchestrating a self-hosted outreach workflow](https://saswatasg.com/blog/tgb-hunt-linkedin-outreach-agent): Task orchestration, campaign state and lessons from building a self-hosted outreach experiment.
- [DhanPlan: monthly planning with visible assumptions](https://saswatasg.com/blog/dhanplan-retirement-calculator): How DhanPlan connects Indian savings instruments, retirement withdrawals, gap-solving and stress scenarios in a versioned monthly model.
- [A data deep-dive that ends in a product decision](https://saswatasg.com/blog/data-deep-dive-method): A practical method for connecting metric definitions, funnel evidence and user workflows to a testable product decision.
- [AI image greetings lifted feature engagement by 168%](https://saswatasg.com/blog/ai-send-greetings-168): A dormant 'Send Greetings' feature, an image-gen model, and a festival calendar across 27 occasions — feature engagement up 168% at LiveKeeping.
- [The 17:1 e-way bill gap: diagnosing B2B adoption](https://saswatasg.com/blog/e-invoice-adoption-gap): A workflow investigation at LiveKeeping identified 17:1 and 19:1 adoption gaps and informed executive product discussions.
- [Daily reporting: three sources, one dependable view](https://saswatasg.com/blog/daily-report-automation): A LiveKeeping reporting workflow using Google Apps Script, 88 mapped rows and three data sources, with freshness and reconciliation made explicit.
- [Discovery that continues into solution delivery](https://saswatasg.com/blog/discovery-to-roadmap): Building discovery at Upcore Technologies: structured research, opportunity prioritization and end-to-end solution delivery ownership for 23+ clients.
- [Notification design: priority, relevance and restraint](https://saswatasg.com/blog/push-notification-architecture): A lifecycle-messaging architecture for LiveKeeping: 27+ triggers, priority tiers, regional relevance and a three-slot daily cap.
- [FilmRisk.AI: what a weak backtest changed](https://saswatasg.com/blog/film-risk-engine): A film-risk experiment with temporal validation, weak baseline comparisons and explicit data limits. What the evaluation changed.
- [Category pages: help customers make the next choice](https://saswatasg.com/blog/category-page-redesign-plus34): A Sierra Living Concepts category-page redesign using analytics and session evidence, with reported lead outcomes kept within their measurement scope.
- [Lead routing: observed signals and explicit pilot targets](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-routing-gold-silver-bronze): Designing a tiered lead-allocation system at Sierra Living Concepts, separating observed source performance from pilot targets.
- [Lead forms: diagnose the field, improve the journey](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-form-overhaul-124): A Sierra Living Concepts form redesign: field-level diagnosis, inline validation and category-specific modules, with reported results in context.
- [One useful change at a time: a growth learning loop](https://saswatasg.com/blog/one-fix-a-week-cro): A practical framework for choosing, shipping and evaluating focused growth improvements without turning activity into a success metric.
- [Checkout friction: from one metric to specific fixes](https://saswatasg.com/blog/checkout-abandonment-73-to-54): A Sierra Living Concepts checkout investigation across 480K sessions, with reported abandonment moving from 73.1% to 53.9%.
